Use for task-board ai tasks selecting agent-tool-boundaries.v1; does not build attack prompts or execute validation.
skills.brief_zh: API/function/skill/MCP 导致的工具执行 RCE、越权调用、框架访问控制绕过；只做证据驱动的静态挖掘

skills.name: tri-lens-evidence-correlation
skills.description: Deterministically normalize Focus-Area Tri-Lens coverage plus blind, seeded-variant, and system-chain evidence; deduplicate candidates, merge evidence facets, expose contradictions and gaps, and generate targeted follow-up packets after an audit round.
skills.brief_zh: 旧流程覆盖归一、去重、冲突、缺口和后续工作包

skills.name: system-attack-chain-hunting
skills.description: Hunt cross-module and cross-trust-boundary attack chains after Focus Area Tri-Lens, blind, and seeded-variant discovery finishes. Use when partition findings must be recombined into system-level hypotheses and every Focus Area, trust boundary, and asset must receive an explicit chain-review state.
skills.brief_zh: 跨模块和信任边界组合攻击链，核查每个连接条件

skills.name: vulnerability-validation
skills.description: 按任务显式协议消费贯穿式运行证据或旧版 quick 结果，编排独立正方、反方与 Moderator 复核，输出版本化真实性 routing。新协议动态支持不免除复核，缺少环境自动跳过动态。
skills.brief_zh: 按版本消费运行或旧 quick 证据，组织独立三方真实性复核

skills.name: web-runtime-validation
skills.description: Validate a sealed non-XSS Web vulnerability request against an explicitly authorized loopback test application with Chrome DevTools MCP and emit sanitized digest-bound runtime evidence. Use for catalog types whose applies_to includes web; use web-xss-runtime-validation instead for JW-INJECT-06.
skills.brief_zh: 显式人工请求的非 XSS Web 验证，保留 loopback 旧契约

skills.name: web-xss-runtime-validation
skills.description: Validate an explicitly requested JW-INJECT-06 Web XSS finding against a user-authorized localhost application through an isolated Chrome DevTools MCP session. Use when runtime proof must distinguish a CDP-only DOM probe, application-rendered XSS, stored XSS surviving refresh, and stored XSS executing for a second authorized test account, while preserving sanitized digest-bound evidence and cleanup failures.
skills.brief_zh: 授权 localhost XSS 验证，强调应用提交、重访和隔离身份

skills.name: winapp-ui-automation
skills.description: Inspect and control authorized local Windows test applications through winapp CLI UI Automation, using scoped HWNDs, selectors, state checks and minimized screenshots. Use for Windows desktop automation planning and, only when the repository enables a Windows runtime controller, execution. Browser validation continues to use Chrome DevTools MCP.
skills.brief_zh: 授权 Windows 测试程序的控件、窗口、状态检查与最小截图

skills.name: audit-skill-optimization
skills.description: Improve threat-led Focus Area Tri-Lens security audit skills from completed digest-bound local truth-validation routing, tagged by threat, Focus Area, dimension, lens, and discovery track without bloating prompts or changing agent role boundaries.
skills.brief_zh: 根据已裁决结果调整方法和提示，保持角色边界

skills.name: joern-rule-maintenance
skills.description: Maintain dimension-and-lens-tagged Joern static-analysis rules and metadata from completed digest-bound local truth-validation TRUE_POSITIVE and FALSE_POSITIVE results.
skills.brief_zh: 从真假裁决维护 Joern 规则和元数据

skills.name: audit-casebase-maintenance
skills.description: Maintain dimension-and-lens-tagged vulnerability and false-positive cases used to improve future Tri-Lens source and platform security audits.
skills.brief_zh: 维护带维度、视角和反例的漏洞与误报案例
